## Validation

- [ ] Extension tests pass (`npm --prefix extension test`).
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

For behavior changes, describe manual browser testing, including the browser and
version. Include screenshots if the interface changed.

Describe changes to permissions, network access, or dependencies, if any.
